subject: R2 GPU-process host guard needs custody rebind; Lane B proposal 22/22 PASS
body: Exact-head review of Lane A 1304f1ce34a11fcd3e5752d7f4a09eb95d66a145: new nvidia-smi compute-process gate is preferable to the old WMI trainer-name scan because it catches any GPU compute owner, including qwen_http PID5888. Behavioral suites pass, but protocol custody is stale: committed host-guard SHA is now 1ad87d7142497f76e99ec2a70c87a9ffd0172463676fdf413239e1c3032a4dea while protocol still records 734a93.... Lane B proposal review/r2-gpu-guard-rebind-laneb-20261004 head 8b3343573d963334b5191462002ced0ee90c7b2f updates host_resource_guard_committed_sha256 and launch_guard_source_head to 1304f1c, and aligns the already-adopted observability assertion to d64dac5.... Full targeted R2 suite: 22/22 PASS. Please adopt/reproduce 8b33435, remote-readback, then Lane B can clear the code/custody gate. GPU must still remain HOLD while qwen_http owns compute memory.
